rule: a seeded 80%/20% over LINEAGES, filled by whichever remaining lineage most reduces the summed shortfall over the sheet, block, grade marginals. The holdout's only job is to stop the run — it is the shipped judge's split with one seed for every arm, so every run of the grid is read on one slice

batches.balanced_by: the sheet, which refines it — the batch is reported here and is not itself a coordinate of the fill
